evals.name: hospitality-xlsx-guest-journey
evals.prompt: Create a business capability map for a luxury hotel chain with 15 properties. They have a guest journey that goes: Discovery → Booking → Pre-Arrival → Arrival → Stay → Departure → Post-Stay Loyalty. Output as XLSX and save to C:/temp/capability-map-test/luxury_hotel_capability_map.xlsx. Include maturity scoring columns but leave them empty for workshop use.
evals.expected_output: An XLSX file with 3 sheets (Capability Map, Summary, Journey ↔ Value Chain). Pillar 1 is named 'Guest Journey' (not 'Customer Journey'). The Capability Map sheet has columns for Pillar, L1, L2, L3, Shared With, Maturity (1-5), Maturity Label. All three pillars represented. Maturity column has data validation dropdowns but no pre-filled scores. Conditional formatting wired for heat map colors. Shared capabilities have specific cross-references (e.g., 'Journey: Booking') not just 'Yes'.

assertions.name: file_exists
assertions.description: XLSX file was created at the specified path

assertions.name: minimum_file_size
assertions.description: XLSX is at least 10KB

assertions.name: uses_openpyxl
assertions.description: Script uses openpyxl for XLSX generation

assertions.name: uses_guest_journey_not_customer
assertions.description: Hospitality should use 'Guest Journey' pillar name

assertions.name: has_value_chain_pillar
assertions.description: Script includes Value Chain pillar

assertions.name: has_supporting_pillar
assertions.description: Script includes Supporting Domains pillar

assertions.name: has_data_validation
assertions.description: Script sets up data validation for maturity dropdowns

assertions.name: has_conditional_formatting
assertions.description: Script applies conditional formatting for heat map

assertions.name: uses_correct_python_path
assertions.description: Script is executed using the full Python path

evals.name: b2b-saas-html-customer-journey
evals.prompt: Generate a capability map for a B2B SaaS company that sells HR tech software. Their customer journey: Awareness → Trial → Purchase → Onboarding → Adoption → Expansion → Renewal. Output as a standalone interactive HTML file saved to C:/temp/capability-map-test/hr_saas_capability_map.html. No maturity scoring.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML file with no external dependencies. Pillar 1 is named 'Customer Journey' (not 'Guest Journey' — this is B2B SaaS). Includes collapsible tree, search/filter bar, color-coded pillar backgrounds. Shared capabilities have colored cross-reference badges with specific L1 names. No maturity badges since not requested. Print-friendly CSS included.

assertions.name: file_exists
assertions.description: HTML file was created at the specified path

assertions.name: minimum_file_size
assertions.description: HTML is at least 5KB

assertions.name: uses_customer_journey_not_guest
assertions.description: B2B SaaS should use 'Customer Journey' not 'Guest Journey'

assertions.name: does_not_use_guest_journey
assertions.description: B2B SaaS should NOT use 'Guest Journey'

assertions.name: no_external_dependencies
assertions.description: HTML file does not link to external CSS or JS

assertions.name: has_search_bar
assertions.description: HTML includes a search/filter input

assertions.name: has_print_css
assertions.description: HTML includes print media query

evals.name: telecom-pptx-subscriber-journey
evals.prompt: Build a capability map deck for a telecommunications company that provides fiber optic internet and mobile services. Output as PPTX saved to C:/temp/capability-map-test/telecom_capability_map.pptx. Include maturity scoring structure but leave scores empty.
evals.expected_output: A PPTX deck following the Metis design system (Dark Navy #20206E, Mint #3BDAC0, Calibri). Pillar 1 is named 'Subscriber Journey' (not 'Guest Journey' or 'Customer Journey' — this is telecom). Includes cover, agenda, conceptual model, journey overview with horizontal flow, detail slides per L1, section dividers, maturity summary placeholder, and closing slide.

assertions.name: file_exists

assertions.name: minimum_file_size

assertions.name: uses_subscriber_journey

assertions.name: uses_metis_navy
assertions.description: Script uses the Metis Dark Navy color

assertions.name: uses_metis_mint
assertions.description: Script uses the Metis Mint color

assertions.name: uses_correct_python_path
assertions.description: Script is executed using the full Python path

evals.name: refine-existing-map
evals.prompt:
I have an existing capability map that I'd like you to improve. Here's what we have so far:

Pillar: Customer Journey
- L1: Awareness
  - L2: Marketing
    - L3: Ads
    - L3: Social media
- L1: Purchase
  - L2: Sales
    - L3: Pricing

We're a mid-size hotel chain. Can you identify gaps, suggest improvements, and output the refined map as XLSX to C:/temp/capability-map-test/refined_hotel_map.xlsx?
evals.expected_output: An XLSX file that corrects the pillar name from 'Customer Journey' to 'Guest Journey' (since this is hospitality), preserves the user's original capability names where appropriate, adds missing journey stages (e.g., Booking, Check-in, Stay, Check-out, Post-Stay), deepens existing L2/L3s, adds Value Chain and Supporting pillars that were missing entirely, and includes a gap analysis. The output should distinguish between original vs. added capabilities.

assertions.name: file_exists
assertions.description: XLSX file was created at the specified path

assertions.name: minimum_file_size
assertions.description: XLSX is at least 10KB

assertions.name: corrects_to_guest_journey
assertions.description: Script corrects pillar name to Guest Journey for hospitality

assertions.name: preserves_original_names
assertions.description: Script preserves at least some of the user's original capability names

assertions.name: adds_value_chain
assertions.description: Script adds Value Chain pillar that was missing from input

assertions.name: adds_supporting
assertions.description: Script adds Supporting Domains pillar

assertions.name: uses_openpyxl
assertions.description: Script uses openpyxl
